title: Gameplan Player Observation Provider Contract v1.2
description: Production boundary contract for player-centric facts supplied by Pro-Scout or another upstream provider. The provider MUST resolve the source player to GSIS before submission. Gameplan validates GSIS but never infers production identity from names or alternate identifiers. effective_at, observed_at and known_at are distinct clocks. v1.2 adds the Anatomy WR/RB factual profile domain.

observation_id.description: Optional provider or transport observation identifier. Gameplan may assign its own immutable observation ID on acceptance.

gsis_id.description: REQUIRED canonical player identity supplied upstream. Names and alternate IDs may never substitute for this field.

source_id.description: Stable provider/source identifier registered with Gameplan.

observed_at.description: When the source asserted/displayed the information.

known_at.description: When Gameplan first possessed this observation. Historical decisions may not use observations learned after their information cutoff.

retrieved_at.description: Optional retrieval time; operationally distinct from source assertion and Gameplan knowledge time.

fact_domain.description: Routes the facts payload to its domain-specific validation contract. Expansion requires an explicit schema/version change. anatomy_profile uses schemas/ingestion/facts/anatomy_profile.schema.json.

source_identity.description: Diagnostic metadata only. These fields never establish or override player identity.

effective.description: Football/business effective period; distinct from source observation, Gameplan knowledge and retrieval times.

facts.description: Source observations. Domain-specific schemas constrain this object downstream; model judgments must not be inserted as Gameplan facts.

quality.description: Optional quality metadata about the source assertion/payload, never probabilistic player identity confidence.
